transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, well, my mom made the appointment. I just... I mostly can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room all day, usually in the same clothes. I used to knit, and journal, and go for walks, but I don't do any of that now. And when my mom asks me what's wrong, I... I barely even have the energy to answer her.
About how long have you been feeling this way?

Well, it's been a while now. I think this whole decline really started when I began a community college program... so, that was about two years and two months ago, I guess. It just kind of started then and never got better.
Throughout these past two years, have you felt persistently sad or down most days?
Um, no, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad or down. It's not like I'm crying or feeling upset about things... I just don't really feel much of anything at all. It's more like I'm just blank.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?
No, I've never had anything like that happen. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's just... like I said, I just feel kind of empty. But no, nothing like hearing voices.
Have you ever felt that people were watching you, plotting against you, or talking about you behind your back?

Yes, actually. Since I was in those college classes, I've known that the school portal and the clinic practicum people were against me. They use... they use these little wording changes in their emails and in the comments on my assignments to mark me as someone they don't want in healthcare. My mom looks at them and says they're just regular messages, but I know what they're really doing.
Have you ever felt like thoughts that were not your own were being placed into your head, or that your thoughts were being taken away?
No, I haven't had that happen. My thoughts are just... they're my own. I've never felt like anyone was putting things in my head or taking them away.
